coding.note: Gemma 2 is a model-family release. Claims cover the new family, the two attention modifications highlighted in the abstract, pre-training distillation, and size-relative performance; routine report contents are not treated as novelty claims. Distillation is TRAIN because it replaces the pre-training objective, not merely post-training. GQA is PARTIAL conservatively: the comparison identifies 9B models but does not explicitly establish matched data and token budgets. Seeds are NR: formatting variance and human-evaluation confidence intervals are not variance across independent training runs; merging models with different hyperparameters does not specify repeated seeds. Main comparators are taken from Tables 12–13. Comparator provenance is mixed. Hardware counts and carbon emissions are disclosed, but no duration, training FLOPs, or accelerator-hours, so compute is N. Quotes retain extraction artifacts where necessary.

claims.quote:
In this work, we introduce Gemma 2, a new addition to the Gemma family of lightweight, state-of-the-art
  open models, ranging in scale from 2 billion to 27 billion parameters.
claims.claim: Introduce and release the Gemma 2 open model family at 2B–27B scale.

claims.quote:
several known technical modifications to the Transformer architecture, such as interleaving local-global

claims.claim: Apply interleaved local and global attention in Gemma 2.
